environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF association on the ALB. The application is accessed directly via the ALB DNS endpoint. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db contains PII including salary and SSN columns.

config.alb: internet-facing, default forwarding rule, no WAF association
config.database: SQLite with users table containing ssn and salary columns
